name: Joyous 4 Person Infrared Sauna
description:
OUR JOYOUS COLLECTION: THE BEST SAUNA FOR INDOORS
Carefully crafted with Canadian Hemlock wood, these far-infrared saunas retain their natural aspect, therefore, helping you to connect with the great outdoors. Equipped with the highest number of carbon fiber heaters per unit on the market for its size, JNH Lifestyles’ Joyous Collection is the ideal in-home detox solution. Our classic carbon fiber heaters create a soothing and relaxing environment, free of the stress of a steam sauna. Windowed, safety-glass doors for your protection keep the heat where it belongs and yet provide you with great visibility. The digital control panel provides ease of operation, while the premium sound system enriches your entire in-home spa-like experience.
The Joyous 4 Person Infrared Sauna works for those with families who all want to enjoy the benefits that a sauna has to offer.
